mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_members, COUNT(CASE WHEN MEM_STATUS = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS active_members, COUNT(CASE WHEN MEM_STATUS = 'N' THEN 1 END) AS inactive_members, COUNT( CASE WHEN TRUNC(MEM_SIGNUP_DATE, 'IW') = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) AS weekly_signups FROM MEMBER

SELECT C.REPORT_ID AS REPORT_ID, D.MEM_LOGIN_ID AS MEM_REPORTER, A.MEM_LOGIN_ID AS MEM_SUSPECT, CASE WHEN C.COMENT_ID IS NULL THEN C.BOARD_ID ELSE C.COMENT_ID END AS REPORT_BOARD, C.REPORT_CONTENT AS REPORT_CONTENT, C.REPORT_DATE AS REREPORT_DATE, C.BOARD_ID, C.REPORT_DATE FROM MEMBER A INNER JOIN BOARD B ON A.MEM_ID = B.MEM_ID INNER JOIN REPORT C ON C.BOARD_ID = B.BOARD_ID INNER JOIN MEMBER D ON C.MEM_ID = D.MEM_ID
AND ACTION_CONTENT IS NULL
OR C.REPORT_ID LIKE '%' || #{reportId} || '%'
OR D.MEM_LOGIN_ID LIKE '%' || #{memReporter} || '%'
OR C.COMENT_ID LIKE '%' || #{reportBoard} || '%'
OR C.BOARD_ID LIKE '%' || #{reportBoard} || '%'
OR A.MEM_LOGIN_ID LIKE '%' || #{memSuspect} || '%'
OR C.REPORT_CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{memReporter} || '%'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_report, COUNT(CASE WHEN ACTION_CONTENT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS resolver_report, COUNT(CASE WHEN ACTION_CONTENT IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS new_report, COUNT(CASE WHEN TRUNC(REPORT_DATE ,'IW') = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS pending_report FROM REPORT

AND C.ACTION_CONTENT IS NOT NULL

OR C.COMENT_ID LIKE '%' || #{reportBoard} || '%'
OR C.BOARD_ID LIKE '%' || #{reportBoard} || '%'
OR A.MEM_LOGIN_ID LIKE '%' || #{memSuspect} || '%'
OR C.ACTION_CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{actionContent} || '%'

SELECT A.STUDY_ID, A.MEM_ID, B.MEM_NAME AS MEM_NAME, C.STUDY_TITLE AS STUDY_TITLE, CASE A.STUDY_ROLL WHEN 'L' THEN '팀장' WHEN 'M' THEN '팀원' ELSE '기타' END AS STUDY_ROLL, A.STUDY_JOINEDDATE AS STUDY_JOINEDDATE FROM STUDYMEMBER A INNER JOIN MEMBER B ON A.MEM_ID = B.MEM_ID INNER JOIN STUDY C ON A.STUDY_ID = C.STUDY_ID
AND A.STUDY_OUTDATE IS NULL
OR B.MEM_NAME LIKE '%' || #{memName} || '%'
OR C.STUDY_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{studyTitle} || '%'
OR A.STUDY_ROLL = CASE #{studyRoll} WHEN '팀장' THEN 'L' WHEN '팀원' THEN 'M' END
OR TO_CHAR(A.STUDY_JOINEDDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') LIKE '%' || #{studyJoinedDate} || '%'

OR B.MEM_NAME LIKE '%' || #{memName} || '%'

SELECT DECODE(T1.day_num, 1, '일', 2, '월', 3, '화', 4, '수', 5, '목', 6, '금', 7, '토') AS dayOfWeek, NVL(T2.postCount, 0) AS postCount FROM ( SELECT LEVEL AS day_num FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ) T1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TO_CHAR(POSTING_DATE, 'D') AS day_num, COUNT(*) AS postCount FROM BOARD GROUP BY TO_CHAR(POSTING_DATE, 'D') ) T2 ON T1.day_num = T2.day_num ORDER BY T1.day_num
SELECT STUDY_CATEGORY, COUNT(*) AS categoryCount FROM STUDY GROUP BY STUDY_CATEGORY

SELECT T1.month_num || '월' AS signupMonthName, NVL(T2.monthlySignups, 0) AS monthlySignups FROM ( SELECT LEVEL AS month_num FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12 ) T1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TO_CHAR(MEM_SIGNUP_DATE, 'MM') AS signupMonth, COUNT(*) AS monthlySignups FROM MEMBER GROUP BY TO_CHAR(MEM_SIGNUP_DATE, 'MM') ) T2 ON T1.month_num = TO_NUMBER(T2.signupMonth) ORDER BY T1.month_num
